row: Veterinary Hospital in Metamora, Michigan. Welcome to our small animal hospital. We are passionate about helping your furry family members live, long, happy and healthy lives. We serve the Metamore and surrounding communities. We provide a full spectrum of veterinary services for most animals, including dental, ophthalmology, nutritional counseling, vaccines, puppy care, kitten care, urgent care and a full array of diagnostics, as well as a completely stocked pharmacy. Give us a call to set an appointment at (810) 678-8740 or come by and visit us.
